role: review proposal; explicit historical cross-overlay routing difference, not equivalence

current_material.observation: Same visible unmodified Escape key predicate and true for non-keydown events; comparative implementation evidence only, no dependency on private symbol.

current_cdk.observation: Public OverlayConfig.eventPredicate directs dispatch to next eligible overlay. The keyboard and outside-pointer dispatchers both consult it.

tag16.behavior: The tooltip hides/prevents/stops on visible unmodified Escape; CDK keyboard dispatcher nevertheless directs any key to top subscribed overlay and stops. Current code deliberately changes cross-overlay dispatch for other keys.

risk: Ordinary and modified keydowns now reach an underlying overlay and may activate it; applications relying on former swallowing can observe a change. Visible unmodified Escape still closes tooltip first, non-keydown predicate remains true, and mouse/touch outside routing is not rejected. Recommendation: retain the minimal public predicate for current Material/CDK integration under delegated conservative source judgment, with the cross-overlay difference explicitly recorded; this is not a claim of exact tagged dispatcher equivalence.

focus_test.scope: One extended existing family case, public FocusMonitor.focusVia keyboard origin with test shim producing synthetic focus; synthetic DOM keys; not trusted OS focus or input, current clean run, all-family run, or native matrix.

limitations: Original 16 top-overlay swallowing changes; do not claim equivalence or hide interoperability risk.
Full shared motion/provider lifecycle remains independently held.
No CSS, selector, product, ledger or consumer API change; prior approved multi-app style-order limitation remains.
Readiness requires adoption of the exact test patch and explicit review of this recorded behavioral difference.
